title: Draft: HyperDHT: add DHT-RPC dissector
description:
## Summary

- Add a native UDP HyperDHT / DHT-RPC dissector.
- Link request and response frames and expose response latency.
- Correlate PING_NAT responses received on an advertised alternate port.
- Decode DELAYED_PING, PLUGIN, mutable storage, FIND_PEER, peer handshake/hole-punch, and announce relay-address payloads.
- Add Expert Info for unknown commands, unknown errors, and trailing data.
- Harden heuristic recognition by requiring a complete top-level packet structure.
- Add regression coverage for protocol values, cross-port PING_NAT correlation, command payloads, malformed heuristic near-matches, and truncated command payloads.

## Local validation

- Current Wireshark master at `3ecd8853`.
- Legacy `tools/checkAPIs.py` and current `tools/check_apis.py`: passed with 0 warnings.
- `cmake --build build-codex --target epan tshark text2pcap --parallel 4`: passed with no `packet-hyperdht.c` compiler warnings.
- `pytest test/suite_dissectors/group_hyperdht.py`: 5 passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

## CI note

The fork pipeline is blocked because GitLab requires account identity verification before CI jobs can run; this is unrelated to the local build/test results above.

## Review status

This remains a draft pending validation against a broader HyperDHT packet corpus and upstream feedback.

This continues an earlier DHT-RPC dissector prototype by James Thomas; the source header retains the original copyright attribution.

AI-assisted development disclosure: OpenAI Codex was used for code quality fixes, protocol-decoder implementation, regression-test construction, local validation, and submission preparation.

Related grant: https://tether.dev/grants/bounties/3122074009/

@@ -0,0 +1,454 @@
+# HyperDHT dissector tests
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+
+import subprocess
+import struct
+
+
+def _make_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path):
+    packets = (
+        bytes.fromhex("03 00 34 12 7f 00 00 01 50 c3 63 aa"),
+        bytes.fromhex("13 08 35 12 7f 00 00 01 50 c3 63"),
+    )
+
+    with open(text_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as capture_text:
+        for packet in packets:
+            capture_text.write("000000  {}\n".format(" ".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in packet)))
+
+    subprocess.check_call(
+        (cmd_text2pcap, "-q", "-u", "20000,20001", text_path, capture_path)
+    )
+
+
+def _internet_checksum(data):
+    if len(data) % 2:
+        data += b"\x00"
+    words = struct.unpack(f"!{len(data) // 2}H", data)
+    value = sum(words)
+    value = (value & 0xFFFF) + (value >> 16)
+    value = (value & 0xFFFF) + (value >> 16)
+    return (~value) & 0xFFFF
+
+
+def _ipv4_udp_frame(payload, src_ip, dst_ip, src_port, dst_port, identification):
+    ethernet = bytes.fromhex("02 00 00 00 00 02 02 00 00 00 00 01 08 00")
+    udp = struct.pack("!HHHH", src_port, dst_port, len(payload) + 8, 0)
+    ip_without_checksum = struct.pack(
+        "!BBHHHBBH4s4s",
+        0x45,
+        0,
+        20 + len(udp) + len(payload),
+        identification,
+        0,
+        64,
+        17,
+        0,
+        src_ip,
+        dst_ip,
+    )
+    ip_checksum = _internet_checksum(ip_without_checksum)
+    ip = ip_without_checksum[:10] + struct.pack("!H", ip_checksum) + ip_without_checksum[12:]
+    return ethernet + ip + udp + payload
+
+
+def _make_ping_nat_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path):
+    client = bytes((192, 0, 2, 10))
+    server = bytes((192, 0, 2, 20))
+    request = bytes.fromhex("03 14 34 12 c0 00 02 14 21 4e 01 02 30 75")
+    response = bytes.fromhex("13 00 34 12 c0 00 02 0a 30 75")
+    frames = (
+        _ipv4_udp_frame(request, client, server, 40000, 20001, 1),
+        _ipv4_udp_frame(response, server, client, 20001, 30000, 2),
+    )
+
+    with open(text_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as capture_text:
+        for frame in frames:
+            for offset in range(0, len(frame), 16):
+                chunk = frame[offset : offset + 16]
+                capture_text.write(
+                    "{:06x}  {}\n".format(offset, " ".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in chunk))
+                )
+
+    subprocess.check_call(
+        (cmd_text2pcap, "-q", "-l", "1", text_path, capture_path)
+    )
+
+
+def _make_command_coverage_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path):
+    client = bytes((192, 0, 2, 10))
+    server = bytes((192, 0, 2, 20))
+    request_to = bytes.fromhex("c0 00 02 14 21 4e")
+    response_to = bytes.fromhex("c0 00 02 0a 20 4e")
+
+    mutable_put = (
+        bytes((0x11,)) * 32
+        + bytes((5, 3))
+        + b"abc"
+        + bytes((0x22,)) * 64
+    )
+    mutable_get_response = bytes((7, 3)) + b"xyz" + bytes((0x44,)) * 64
+    find_peer_response = (
+        bytes((0x66,)) * 32
+        + bytes((1, 198, 51, 100, 7, 0x49, 0xC2))
+    )
+
+    payloads = (
+        bytes.fromhex("03 14 01 20") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("04 04 88 13 00 00"),
+        bytes.fromhex("03 10 02 20")
+        + request_to
+        + bytes.fromhex("0a 0c 04 64 65 6d 6f 02 07 01 03 61 62 63"),
+        bytes.fromhex("03 18 03 20")
+        + request_to
+        + bytes((6,))
+        + bytes((0x33,)) * 32
+        + bytes((len(mutable_put),))
+        + mutable_put,
+        bytes.fromhex("03 18 04 20")
+        + request_to
+        + bytes((7,))
+        + bytes((0x33,)) * 32
+        + bytes((1, 7)),
+        bytes.fromhex("13 10 04 20")
+        + response_to
+        + bytes((len(mutable_get_response),))
+        + mutable_get_response,
+        bytes.fromhex("03 08 05 20")
+        + request_to
+        + bytes((2,))
+        + bytes((0x55,)) * 32,
+        bytes.fromhex("13 10 05 20")
+        + response_to
+        + bytes((len(find_peer_response),))
+        + find_peer_response,
+        bytes.fromhex("03 18 06 20")
+        + request_to
+        + bytes((0,))
+        + bytes((0x77,)) * 32
+        + bytes.fromhex("04 00 00 01 aa"),
+        bytes.fromhex("13 10 06 20")
+        + response_to
+        + bytes.fromhex("0b 01 04 02 bb cc cb 00 71 09 39 30"),
+    )
+
+    frames = []
+    for index, payload in enumerate(payloads, start=1):
+        response = payload[0] == 0x13
+        frames.append(
+            _ipv4_udp_frame(
+                payload,
+                server if response else client,
+                client if response else server,
+                20001 if response else 20000,
+                20000 if response else 20001,
+                index,
+            )
+        )
+
+    with open(text_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as capture_text:
+        for frame in frames:
+            for offset in range(0, len(frame), 16):
+                chunk = frame[offset : offset + 16]
+                capture_text.write(
+                    "{:06x}  {}\n".format(offset, " ".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in chunk))
+                )
+
+    subprocess.check_call((cmd_text2pcap, "-q", "-l", "1", text_path, capture_path))
+
+
+def _make_heuristic_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path):
+    client = bytes((192, 0, 2, 10))
+    server = bytes((192, 0, 2, 20))
+    to = bytes.fromhex("c0 00 02 14 21 4e")
+    valid = bytes.fromhex("03 14 07 20") + to + bytes.fromhex("04 04 88 13 00 00")
+    malformed = bytes.fromhex("03 10 08 20") + to + bytes.fromhex("0a 05 aa")
+    frames = (
+        _ipv4_udp_frame(valid, client, server, 31000, 31001, 1),
+        _ipv4_udp_frame(malformed, client, server, 32000, 32001, 2),
+    )
+
+    with open(text_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as capture_text:
+        for frame in frames:
+            for offset in range(0, len(frame), 16):
+                chunk = frame[offset : offset + 16]
+                capture_text.write(
+                    "{:06x}  {}\n".format(offset, " ".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in chunk))
+                )
+
+    subprocess.check_call((cmd_text2pcap, "-q", "-l", "1", text_path, capture_path))
+
+
+def _make_truncated_command_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path):
+    client = bytes((192, 0, 2, 10))
+    server = bytes((192, 0, 2, 20))
+    request_to = bytes.fromhex("c0 00 02 14 21 4e")
+    response_to = bytes.fromhex("c0 00 02 0a 20 4e")
+
+    payloads = (
+        (bytes.fromhex("03 14 01 40") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("01 01 aa"), False),
+        (bytes.fromhex("03 14 02 40") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("03 05 01 02 03 04 05"), False),
+        (bytes.fromhex("03 10 03 40") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("00 01 01"), False),
+        (bytes.fromhex("03 10 04 40") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("01 02 01 02"), False),
+        (bytes.fromhex("03 10 05 40") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("04 01 01"), False),
+        (bytes.fromhex("03 10 06 40") + request_to + bytes.fromhex("07 01 fd"), False),
+        (
+            bytes.fromhex("03 08 07 40")
+            + request_to
+            + bytes((3,))
+            + bytes((0x55,)) * 32,
+            False,
+        ),
+        (bytes.fromhex("13 10 07 40") + response_to + bytes.fromhex("01 01"), True),
+        (bytes.fromhex("13 10 03 40") + response_to + bytes.fromhex("01 01"), True),
+    )
+
+    frames = []
+    for index, (payload, response) in enumerate(payloads, start=1):
+        frames.append(
+            _ipv4_udp_frame(
+                payload,
+                server if response else client,
+                client if response else server,
+                20001 if response else 20000,
+                20000 if response else 20001,
+                index,
+            )
+        )
+
+    with open(text_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as capture_text:
+        for frame in frames:
+            for offset in range(0, len(frame), 16):
+                chunk = frame[offset : offset + 16]
+                capture_text.write(
+                    "{:06x}  {}\n".format(offset, " ".join(f"{byte:02x}" for byte in chunk))
+                )
+
+    subprocess.check_call((cmd_text2pcap, "-q", "-l", "1", text_path, capture_path))
+
+
+def _fields(cmd_tshark, capture_path, display_filter, fields, env):
+    command = [
+        cmd_tshark,
+        "-2",
+        "-r",
+        capture_path,
+        "-d",
+        "udp.port==20001,hyperdht",
+        "-Y",
+        display_filter,
+        "-T",
+        "fields",
+    ]
+    for field in fields:
+        command.extend(("-e", field))
+
+    return subprocess.check_output(command, encoding="utf-8", env=env).strip()
+
+
+def _heuristic_fields(cmd_tshark, capture_path, display_filter, fields, env):
+    command = [
+        cmd_tshark,
+        "-2",
+        "-r",
+        capture_path,
+        "-Y",
+        display_filter,
+        "-T",
+        "fields",
+    ]
+    for field in fields:
+        command.extend(("-e", field))
+
+    return subprocess.check_output(command, encoding="utf-8", env=env).strip()
+
+
+class TestHyperDHT:
+    def test_unknown_command_and_trailing_data_experts(
+        self, cmd_tshark, cmd_text2pcap, result_file, test_env
+    ):
+        text_path = result_file("txt")
+        capture_path = result_file("pcapng")
+        _make_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path)
+
+        unknown_command = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 1",
+            ("hyperdht.command", "_ws.expert.message", "hyperdht.trailing"),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert unknown_command == (
+            "99\tUnrecognized HyperDHT command: 99,"
+            "Trailing bytes after end of message\taa"
+        )
+
+        unknown_error = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 2",
+            ("hyperdht.error", "_ws.expert.message"),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert unknown_error == "63\tUnrecognized DHT-RPC error code: 99"
+
+    def test_ping_nat_links_response_on_advertised_port(
+        self, cmd_tshark, cmd_text2pcap, result_file, test_env
+    ):
+        text_path = result_file("txt")
+        capture_path = result_file("pcapng")
+        _make_ping_nat_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path)
+
+        response_frame = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 1",
+            ("hyperdht.response_in",),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert response_frame == "2"
+
+        request_and_latency = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 2",
+            ("hyperdht.request_in", "hyperdht.response_time"),
+            test_env,
+        ).split("\t")
+        assert request_and_latency[0] == "1"
+        assert request_and_latency[1]
+
+    def test_command_payload_decoders(
+        self, cmd_tshark, cmd_text2pcap, result_file, test_env
+    ):
+        text_path = result_file("txt")
+        capture_path = result_file("pcapng")
+        _make_command_coverage_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path)
+
+        delayed_ping = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 1",
+            ("hyperdht.command", "hyperdht.delayed_ping.delay"),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert delayed_ping == "4\t5000"
+
+        plugin = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 2",
+            (
+                "hyperdht.command",
+                "hyperdht.plugin.name",
+                "hyperdht.plugin.version",
+                "hyperdht.plugin.command",
+                "hyperdht.plugin.flag.value",
+                "hyperdht.plugin.value",
+            ),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert plugin == "10\tdemo\t2\t7\tTrue\t616263"
+
+        mutable_put_fields = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 3",
+            (
+                "hyperdht.mutable_put.public_key",
+                "hyperdht.mutable_put.seq",
+                "hyperdht.mutable_put.value",
+                "hyperdht.mutable_put.signature",
+            ),
+            test_env,
+        ).split("\t")
+        assert mutable_put_fields == ["11" * 32, "5", "616263", "22" * 64]
+
+        mutable_get_fields = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 5",
+            (
+                "hyperdht.mutable_get.response.seq",
+                "hyperdht.mutable_get.response.value",
+                "hyperdht.mutable_get.response.signature",
+            ),
+            test_env,
+        ).split("\t")
+        assert mutable_get_fields == ["7", "78797a", "44" * 64]
+
+        find_peer = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 7",
+            (
+                "hyperdht.find_peer_reply.peer",
+                "hyperdht.peer.ipv4",
+                "hyperdht.peer.port",
+            ),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert find_peer == (
+            f"{'66' * 32}\t192.0.2.10,198.51.100.7\t20000,49737"
+        )
+
+        handshake_reply = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 9",
+            (
+                "hyperdht.peer_handshake.mode",
+                "hyperdht.peer_handshake.peer.addr",
+                "hyperdht.peer_handshake.peer.port",
+            ),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert handshake_reply == "4\t203.0.113.9\t12345"
+
+    def test_heuristic_requires_complete_top_level_structure(
+        self, cmd_tshark, cmd_text2pcap, result_file, test_env
+    ):
+        text_path = result_file("txt")
+        capture_path = result_file("pcapng")
+        _make_heuristic_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path)
+
+        valid = _heuristic_fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 1",
+            ("hyperdht.version", "hyperdht.delayed_ping.delay"),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert valid == "3\t5000"
+
+        malformed = _heuristic_fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "frame.number == 2",
+            ("hyperdht.version",),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert malformed == ""
+
+    def test_truncated_command_payloads_do_not_raise_malformed_exceptions(
+        self, cmd_tshark, cmd_text2pcap, result_file, test_env
+    ):
+        text_path = result_file("txt")
+        capture_path = result_file("pcapng")
+        _make_truncated_command_capture(cmd_text2pcap, text_path, capture_path)
+
+        decoded_frames = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "hyperdht",
+            ("frame.number",),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert decoded_frames.splitlines() == [str(frame) for frame in range(1, 10)]
+
+        malformed_frames = _fields(
+            cmd_tshark,
+            capture_path,
+            "_ws.malformed",
+            ("frame.number",),
+            test_env,
+        )
+        assert malformed_frames == ""
